variants.title: Dispersion and band gap of a diatomic LC lattice
variants.sample: LC ladder with alternating capacitors, 0.1 uF and 0.047 uF
variants.unknown: the dispersion relation, the cut-off of the acoustic branch and the band gap
variants.note: Alternating capacitors play two different masses: the acoustic branch ends at sqrt(2 / L C1) / 2 pi and the optical branch starts at sqrt(2 / L C2) / 2 pi; no wave travels in between. Component values are illustrative.

source.title: C. Kittel, Introduction to Solid State Physics, ch. 4: the diatomic chain
